descriptionChirho: The geographical region of Judea (Ἰουδαία), the southern province of Palestine centered on Jerusalem; used as a proper noun in various cases (genitive, nominative, dative, accusative) to denote origin, location, or destination. All three clusters represent the same geographical referent with identical translations across languages: eng 'Judea/Ioudaia', spa 'Judea/Ioudaía', hin यहूदिया, arb يَهُودِيَّةِ, kor 유대/유다, swa 'Yudea'. The minor orthographic variations (e.g., hin यहोओदियअ vs यहूदिया) are transliteration variants, not semantic distinctions.
